\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=newest}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=8cm,
    height=6cm,
    view={335}{35},
    domain=-1:1,
    y domain=-1:1,
    samples=11,
    xlabel={$x$},
    ylabel={$y$},
    zlabel={$xy$},
    title={Bilinear surface},
    grid=major,
    colorbar left,
    colorbar style={ytick={-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1},title={$z$}}
  ]
    \addplot3[surf] {x*y};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
